Overview.Name: K Priyanka
Overview.Goal: Fat loss and improving diabetes and PCOS control to support long-term health.

Early_Morning: Option 3: Warm water + small bowl curd
Meal_1_Breakfast: Option 1: Vegetable omelette (2 eggs) + small bowl curd
Option 2: Paneer bhurji (pan fried) + cooked vegetables
Option 3: Rice rawa upma (small portion) with vegetables
Meal_2_Lunch: Option 1: Chicken curry (pressure cooked) + small portion plain rice + vegetables
Option 2: Fish curry + small portion plain rice + vegetable stir fry
Option 3: Paneer curry + small portion plain rice + vegetables
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Puffed rice with onion and salt (dry)
Meal_3_Dinner: Option 3: Curd bowl with cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Keep rice portions small and eat slowly to support blood sugar control.
Prefer pressure cooked or pan fried foods with minimal oil.
Keep dinner lighter than lunch on most days.
For stress eating, pause for 5 minutes and drink water before eating.
Use spices for taste instead of adding more oil.
On busy days, eggs, curd, milk, and leftover curry with vegetables are enough.
Consistency with routine, sleep, and meals matters more than perfection.
